name: relay-chat
description: Relay - a real-time team chat platform (Slack/Discord style) built to learn how real products scale.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,gateway,workers,web -c blue,magenta,yellow,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/gateway" "npm run dev -w apps/workers" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.deps:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis redpanda
